evidence_quotes: Construcao de loteamento em area de manaciais.
construção de loteamento em área de proteção de mananciais.
rationale: This TJSP decision addresses municipal and private liability for constructing a subdivision (loteamento) inside a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais) without taking adequate measures to prevent environmental damage. Under Protocol Rule 1, Brazilian mananciais protection cases are classified as WATER. Under Protocol Rule 2, because the dispute concerns land-use/subdivision enforcement and liability in an área de proteção de mananciais without direct water utility service access or direct water abstraction/effluent adjudication, strict_service_access_label is marked UNCERTAIN. The primary governance category is environmental_protection (manancial protection), and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false because household water/sewer service access is not at issue.
